title: Video overview of the Knowledge Portal Network
summary: See a video overview of the Knowledge Portal Network.
bodyHtml: Recently we presented in the Molecular and Population Genetics Primer series at the Broad Institute. The Primers are instructional talks on topics in genetics and genomics. In this talk, we gave an overview of the Knowledge Portal project and demonstrated how to navigate the Portals.
